text: I called about twenty minutes ago because I have a burst pipe in my basement and nobody has called me back yet! Water is still coming in.

I'm so sorry to hear that. First, please make sure your main water valve is turned off right away if you haven't already.

Could I get your address and callback phone number so I can get a technician paged for you?
It's 61 Ashland Avenue in Buffalo. And my phone number is 716-555-0309.
